notes: Read live 2026-10-07 in headed Chrome from a residential connection, nothing submitted. The name page /name/John-Smith/Houston-TX (the form on the home page sends the visitor to a Spokeo search instead, and the comma form of the city answers a 403 hop before it redirects here) lists 7 .record cards with the name, Lives in, Born (age) and redacted phone numbers. Every link on a card is a span with a base64 x-href attribute that a script turns into a click, so no card has an href and no per person URL can be read; the only target they reach is the shared /name/John-Smith page. A scan therefore cannot produce confirmable candidates, and the recipe ends as blocked for a person or agent whenever the page lists records. The a.record-link selector after that matches nothing, so a name with no results (the site answers 404 with "No Results Found") ends with an empty list. The Cloudflare check passed in a plain Chrome and blocked a Playwright launched one with a 403, so a worker run may end as bot_detection first. The opt-out page loads and has a form (#name, #street, #city, #state, #zip, #email, #phone) with a Turnstile widget.
